findings.disposition: exempted: the series' envelope and its two limit-reaching spikes read, and the same readings are quantified in the section's evidence table.
findings.summary: The blue series is sampled densely enough that over sustained stretches (roughly 30-60 h and 95-110 h) it renders as a near-solid band several percentage points thick, so individual excursions inside those stretches are hard to distinguish. The envelope and the two near-limit spikes remain readable.

findings.disposition: exempted: the caption states both red markers are the two dated kill events, and both markers sit inside the same annotation's visual group.
findings.summary: The 'OOM kills' annotation is attached by its leader line to the right-hand red marker only; the left marker near 35 h carries no arrow or direct label, so a reader who skips the caption cannot tell whether it is the same kind of event.

findings.disposition: exempted: the caption names the baseline as the job that lives 64 hours, so the shorter span is stated in the caption.
findings.summary: The grey baseline series ends abruptly near 62 h while the axis runs to about 130 h and the blue series continues to about 118 h; in-figure the termination looks the same as missing data, since nothing marks the baseline's shorter run.

rubric_items.contrast: Pass. Text sampled against white: legend 19.7:1, tick labels 7.9:1, both threshold annotations 5.0:1. The grey data stroke is 3.2:1, over 3:1 for a graphical object.
rubric_items.data_ink: Pass. Ink is spent on six things only: the two series, the 80% and 90% threshold rules, the two kill markers and the annotation. No fill, no gradient, white ground.
rubric_items.decoration: Pass. No gridlines, no shading, no background fill, no title or suptitle; only the bottom and left spines are drawn.
rubric_items.label_collision: Pass. No text is clipped by the canvas edge or overlaps another label or the data; the right-hand threshold labels sit outside the axes, and the kill annotation sits in clear space above the blue trace.
rubric_items.legibility: Pass. Axes name their quantities with units (job memory [% of limit], hours since job start); a frameless two-entry legend sits above the plot; the grey baseline's ceiling-bound excursion and the blue job's near-half-limit trace are distinguishable at a glance.
rubric_items.table_form: Pass. A continuous time series over 0-118 h plotted against hours since job start; the tabulated readings the section wants live in the evidence table, not in the figure.
